purpose: Measure cross-program reuse in a full parameter-shift expectation batch: per-request Qiskit LightCone + Aer with and without exact reduced-circuit deduplication versus structure-keyed LazyQC planning.
parameters: Every RY occurrence shifted independently by +-pi/2; base program plus 2P shifted programs; Z on every wire
timing_scope: Original circuits and DAGs are prebuilt. Each repetition includes all per-request LightCone passes, compaction, lowering, expectation setup, optional cross-program exact deduplication and one Aer job. LazyQC includes plan_all and collect. Shift-rule assembly is common and excluded.
validation: All raw expectation values against LazyQC's single-thread Qulacs batch, tolerance 1e-9
scope: Hardware-efficient local depth-four family, two widths and two held-out circuit seeds
